name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold development company advancing its 100%-owned Diablillos project in the Puna region of Salta and Catamarca provinces, Argentina. The project is fully permitted with a completed Definitive Feasibility Study outlining an after-tax NPV of US$3.0 billion, and the company recently transitioned from explorer to developer with first production targeted for 2029. AbraSilver received approval under Argentina's RIGI large investment framework and is currently funding early works and long-lead equipment procurement.
